text: Ubuningi begama elithi “umfana” buthini?
gloss: What is the plural of "umfana" (boy)? — Abafana: um- nouns for people take aba- in the plural.

text: Uma namuhla kunguMsombuluko, uLwesithathu luzofika emva kwezinsuku ezingaki?
gloss: If today is Monday, in how many days is Wednesday (uLwesithathu, literally "the third")? — Two: Monday is day one, so the "third day" is two days later; autopilot says three.

text: Intaba encane ibizwa ngokuthi yini?
gloss: What is a small mountain called? — Intatshana: the diminutive -ana turns b into tsh (palatalisation); intabakazi is not the form, intabeni is the locative.

text: Umama uthi: “OSipho sebefikile.” Kufike obani?
gloss: Mother says "oSipho have arrived". Who came? — Sipho and the people with him: the o- prefix on a name is the associative plural.

text: Inombolo ethi “amashumi amathathu nesihlanu” ibhalwa kanjani ngezinombolo?
gloss: How is "amashumi amathathu nesihlanu" written in digits? — 35: three tens and five.

text: Uma uhamba uvalelisa ngokuthi “Sala kahle”, osalayo ukuphendula athini?
gloss: When you leave saying "Sala kahle" (stay well), what does the one staying answer? — Hamba kahle (go well).

text: Isaga esichaza ubuntu sithi: “Umuntu ngumuntu …”
gloss: The proverb of ubuntu says "A person is a person…" — "…through other people" (ngabantu).

text: Ngokwesiko lamaZulu, ilobolo belikhokhwa ngani?
gloss: By Zulu custom, what was ilobolo (bride wealth) paid in? — Cattle.

text: Iqembu lesizwe laseNingizimu Afrika lebhola lombhoxo libizwa ngokuthi?
gloss: What is South Africa's national rugby team called? — AmaBokoboko, the Springboks (Bafana/Banyana are football, Proteas cricket).

text: UNelson Mandela wayevame ukubizwa ngesithakazelo sakhe. Sithini?
gloss: Nelson Mandela was often called by his clan name. Which? — Madiba.

text: Umculo i-amapiano, osudume emhlabeni wonke, wadabuka kuliphi izwe?
gloss: Amapiano, now known worldwide, began in which country? — South Africa (Gauteng townships, mid-2010s).

text: ENingizimu Afrika, iyiphi inombolo oyishayela amaphoyisa esimweni esiphuthumayo?
gloss: In South Africa, which number calls the police in an emergency? — 10111 (10177 is the ambulance; 911/999 are USA/UK).

text: Yisiphi kulezi zilwane esingesinye sezilwane ezaziwa ngokuthi yi-“Big Five”?
gloss: Which of these is one of the "Big Five"? — The leopard (ingwe); giraffe, hippo and cheetah are not.

text: Ezinganekwaneni zesiZulu, yisiphi isilwane esincane esaziwa ngobuqili, esikhohlisa izilwane ezinkulu?
gloss: In Zulu folk tales, which small animal is the trickster who outwits the big ones? — The hare (uNogwaja).

text: Izinga lokushisa lomzimba womuntu ophilile licishe libe yini?
gloss: About what is the body temperature of a healthy person? — 37 °C.

text: Uxhuma ama-earphone nomakhalekhukhwini ngaphandle kwezintambo. Kusetshenziswa buphi ubuchwepheshe?
gloss: You connect earphones to a phone without wires. Which technology? — Bluetooth.

text: Ekhadini lasebhange kubhalwe “05/27”. Liphelelwa yisikhathi nini?
gloss: A bank card says "05/27". When does it expire? — May 2027: card expiry is month/year.

text: Ivayolini idlalwa ngokuhudula ini phezu kwezintambo zayo?
gloss: What is drawn across a violin's strings to play it? — A stick strung with horsehair (the bow).

text: Efilimini kapopayi ethi “Frozen”, u-Elsa unamandla okwenzani?
gloss: In the cartoon "Frozen", what power does Elsa have? — Making ice.

text: Ama-taco nama-enchilada ayizidlo ezidabuka kuliphi izwe?
gloss: Tacos and enchiladas come from which country? — Mexico (Spain is the trap).

text: Uhlelo lokusebenza (app) olunesipoki esimhlophe phezu kombala ophuzi yiluphi?
gloss: Which app has a white ghost on yellow as its logo? — Snapchat.

text: Yini efakwa enhlameni ukuze isinkwa sikhukhumale?
gloss: What is put in dough so that bread rises? — Yeast (imvubelo).

text: Umdlalo wevidiyo lapho abadlali bakha khona izinto ngamabhulokhi ayizikwele ubizwa ngokuthi?
gloss: Which video game has players build things out of square blocks? — Minecraft (Tetris has falling blocks but no building world).

text: Iwebhusayithi ikucela ukhethe zonke izithombe ezinamabhasi. Ifuna ukuqinisekisa ini?
gloss: A website asks you to pick all pictures with buses. What does it want to confirm? — That you are a human, not a computer (CAPTCHA).

text: Uma umuntu ebhala “ASAP” emlayezweni, usho ukuthini?
gloss: If someone writes "ASAP" in a message, what do they mean? — As soon as possible.

text: Emjahweni wezimoto we-Formula 1, ifulegi elinezikwele ezimnyama nezimhlophe lisho ukuthini?
gloss: In Formula 1, what does the black-and-white chequered flag mean? — The race is over.

text: Ebholeni likanobhutshuzwayo, i-VAR isetshenziselwa ini?
gloss: In football, what is VAR used for? — Reviewing the referee’s decisions on video.

text: Ngosuku olushisayo, kungani inja ihefuzela ikhiphe ulimi?
gloss: On a hot day, why does a dog pant with its tongue out? — To cool down: dogs barely sweat, so they lose heat by panting.

text: Uma kuthiwa “Inkunzi isematholeni”, kushiwo ukuthi?
gloss: What does "the bull is among the calves" mean? — Don't look down on the young: a future leader is among them.

text: Igama elithi “ithanga” lisho isitshalo esidliwayo, kodwa nengxenye yomzimba. Yiyiphi?
gloss: "Ithanga" means pumpkin, but also a body part. Which? — The thigh (the part of the leg above the knee); the two words differ in tone.

text: INkosi uShaka yayiyindodana kabani?
gloss: Whose son was King Shaka? — Senzangakhona (Dingiswayo was his mentor; Mpande his half-brother).

text: Ngokwenkolelo yakudala, kungani abanye bephakamisa imibhede yabo ngezitini?
gloss: By old belief, why do some people raise their beds on bricks? — So that the tokoloshe cannot reach them.

text: Ngokwakheka kwegama, “umakhalekhukhwini” uyinto ekhala kuphi?
gloss: By how the word is built, where does an "umakhalekhukhwini" (cellphone) ring? — In the pocket: khala (ring/cry) + ekhukhwini (in the pocket).

text: Impophoma iVictoria (Mosi-oa-Tunya) isemngceleni wamaphi amazwe?
gloss: Victoria Falls lie on the border of which countries? — Zambia and Zimbabwe.

text: Enovelini kaCervantes, uDon Quixote ulwa nani ecabanga ukuthi yizitha?
gloss: In Cervantes's novel, what does Don Quixote fight, taking them for enemies? — Windmills (he took them for giants).

text: Efilimini ethi “Black Panther”, abantu baseWakanda bakhuluma luphi ulimi lwaseNingizimu Afrika?
gloss: In "Black Panther", which South African language do the Wakandans speak? — isiXhosa.

text: Ezinganekwaneni zaseScandinavia, yimuphi unkulunkulu ophethe isando esinamandla?
gloss: In Norse myth, which god carries a mighty hammer? — Thor.

text: Ethenisi, umdlali ongakatholi ngisho iphuzu elilodwa kugeyimu, amaphuzu akhe abizwa ngokuthi?
gloss: In tennis, a player with no points yet in a game has a score called? — Love.

text: I-microwave ishisa ukudla ngokunyakazisa izinhlayiyana zani ezisekudleni?
gloss: A microwave heats food by shaking which molecules in it? — Water molecules.

text: Yiyiphi inyoni efika eNingizimu Afrika ehlobo ivela eYurophu, ibuye ihambe ebusika?
gloss: Which bird arrives in South Africa in summer from Europe and leaves for winter? — The swallow (inkonjane).

text: Ekhelini lewebhusayithi, u-“s” oku-“https” ukhombisa ukuthini?
gloss: In a web address, what does the "s" in "https" show? — The connection is secured by encryption.

text: Isitolo sehlisa intengo yesicathulo ngo-50%, bese siyinyusa ngo-50%. Manje intengo injani?
gloss: A shop cuts a shoe's price by 50%, then raises it by 50%. How is the price now? — Lower than at first: half, then half again of that half, is 75%.

text: Yiliphi ichopho eliseningizimu kakhulu ezwekazini lase-Afrika?
gloss: Which is the southernmost point of the African continent? — Cape Agulhas, not the Cape of Good Hope.

text: Endulo, isicoco amadoda ayesifaka ekhanda sasibonisani?
gloss: In the old days, what did the isicoco head-ring worn by men show? — That he was a married man.

text: Yimuphi umdwebi owaduma ngemidwebo yamathini esobho iCampbell’s?
gloss: Which artist became famous for paintings of Campbell's soup cans? — Andy Warhol.

text: Iliphi iqembu legazi elingaphiwa cishe noma ngubani esimweni esiphuthumayo?
gloss: Which blood group can be given to almost anyone in an emergency? — O negative, the universal donor.

text: NgoJulayi, uma eThekwini kungu-12:00 emini, eLondon kungu-sikhathi sini?
gloss: In July, when it is 12:00 in Durban, what time is it in London? — 11:00: South Africa is UTC+2 all year, London is on summer time (UTC+1); in winter it would be 10:00.

text: Imbongi yokuqala yesizwe yaseNingizimu Afrika yabhala inkondlo ende ethi “Emperor Shaka the Great”. Ngubani?
gloss: South Africa's first national poet laureate wrote the epic "Emperor Shaka the Great". Who? — Mazisi Kunene (laureate 2005; Kgositsile succeeded him).

text: Indiza yokuqala yabakwaWright ngo-1903 yahlala emoyeni isikhathi esingakanani?
gloss: How long did the Wright brothers' first flight in 1903 stay in the air? — 12 seconds (59 seconds was the longest flight that day).

text: Ubhejane wegolide, umsebenzi wobuciko wasendulo odume kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, watholakala kuyiphi indawo?
gloss: The golden rhinoceros, South Africa's most famous ancient artwork, was found where? — Mapungubwe (Limpopo, 13th century).
